posts.title: The Bluest Eye by Toni Morrison
posts.description: This book is art. It's incredibly poetic, beginning with a children's story of a perfect house and family assumed to be white but never stated. It isn't enjoyable—it's a hard read for the level of tragedy, shame, and disgust. It was very difficult to process.
